svg.title: LSM tree compaction process
svg.desc: Writes enter a memtable, flush as SSTables into Level 0, then compact downward into larger sorted runs at Level 1 and Level 2, with overlapping key ranges merged and obsolete entries discarded.
svg.text: Each level grows ~10× larger; compaction reclaims space from
overwritten keys and tombstones as data settles downward.
